incident-bot: PAGING: High-severity metering anomaly -> token-count divergence detected for prod-emitter cluster (alert: METRIC-TOKEN-DRIFT). Please ACK and take ownership if on-call.

sam (oncall): Acked. I'm taking it. ETA 2m to triage. @maria can you pull the ledger diffs? :eyes:

maria (sre): Looking now. Early summary: emitter-a is emitting normal throughput but the shadow-agg process is lagging and replays are producing duplicate token batches. Counts diverging since 00:04 UTC, now ~18% delta.

sam (oncall): Are customers being flagged for overage?

jake (billing): We already got 2 automated overage flags from the downstream billing pipeline (cust IDs redacted in logs). Flags triggered at 00:07 UTC when shadow counts exceeded threshold. Support notified.

lina (support): Received initial customer alerts. Opening high-priority tickets for impacted accounts, monitoring any payment/alert churn. Will post updates.

maria (sre): Quick logs from emitter and shadow, trimming noise:
```
[00:05:12] emitter-a: produced batch id=bb-307 size=412 tokens
[00:05:13] shadow-agg: ack batch id=bb-307 status=OK latency=312ms
[00:06:02] emitter-a: produced batch id=bb-412 size=398 tokens
[00:06:05] shadow-agg: replayed batch id=bb-412 (duplicate) cause=replay_on_retry
[00:07:10] shadow-agg: window-commit failed, fallback to immediate-emit -> duplicated counts
```

sam (oncall): Hypothesis: retry/replay loop on the shadow pipeline caused duplicates which were ingested by billing. Any quick mitigation?

maria (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) Pause shadow-agg replay consumer (non-critical for real-time billing; it's used for redundancy). 2) Enable dedupe flag on the ingestion path (hotfix config). 3) Backfill reconciliation to remove duplicates from billing ledger.

sam (oncall): Execute 1 & 2 now. I'll coordinate with billing for step 3.

maria (sre): Paused shadow-agg replay consumer at 00:12 UTC. Toggling dedupe flag on ingestion now: config set dedupe=true for shard-12. Patch applied.

jake (billing): Seen ingestion dedupe flag flip. Downstream billing rate of flagged overages dropped immediately. We'll hold off customer-facing charge changes until reconciliation completes.

lina (support): Notifying impacted customers: "We've identified a metering processing issue that may have produced overage alerts. We're investigating; charges will not be finalized until we reconcile. Sorry for the noise." Posted to two active tickets.

sam (oncall): Good. How long to reconcile ledger? Rough ETA?

jake (billing): Initial estimate 3-6 hours for full ledger reconciliation and reprocessing. We can push a partial reconciliation to unflag customers within ~45m for the highest-severity accounts.

maria (sre): Monitoring metrics: token-delta rate fell to ~2% within 3m after pause + dedupe. Attach quick check snippet:
```
// query: SELECT sum(tokens_delta) FROM token_shadows WHERE minute >= "2026-03-17T00:00" GROUP BY minute LIMIT 10
results -> [ +0.18, +0.17, +0.02, +0.01, +0.00 ]
```

sam (oncall): Assigning handoff: I'll stay for immediate mitigation, but need to hand to jake for billing reconciliation and customer comms. @jake you're primary for the next 6h. @maria please keep an eye on any repeat replays.

jake (billing): Taking it. I'll coordinate with accounting to pause any billing finalization and kick off the reconciliation job. Creating internal incident ticket INC-2026-842.

lina (support): I'll keep customers updated on progress. Requesting list of impacted account IDs + contact owners.

jake (billing): Pushing impacted list to the incident doc and to support channel now (shared link).

maria (sre): One more note: root cause appears to be a subtle race in the replay backoff handler that caused duplicate enqueue when acks were delayed by a downstream circuit-breaker. I'll open PR for backoff fix and schedule postmortem.

sam (oncall): Thanks. Steps summary in thread: 
- ACK & owner: sam (oncall) -> triage.
- Quick mitigation: paused shadow replays + enable dedupe on ingestion -> maria applied.
- Billing action: jake pause finalization + run reconciliation job -> jake owns.
- Support comms: lina informs customers and holds firmer comms until reconciliation.
- RCA/PR: maria to open bug/PR for backoff race.

incident-bot: Note: Pager resolved (mitigations applied) but incident remains open until billing reconciliation completes.

jake (billing): Reconciliation started at 00:45 UTC. Partial unflag of top 5 affected customers completed at 01:30 UTC. Full job ETA ~03:00 UTC. Will update incident doc with ledger deltas and final billing decision.

lina (support): Customers acknowledged the temporary message. No escalations yet. One customer asked for a credit hold; accounting says we'll decide post-recon.

maria (sre): PR opened for replay backoff fix: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4217. Adding postmortem tag.

sam (oncall): Handing over final watch to jake and maria. I'll sign out in 30m. If anything spikes re-open pager.

jake (billing): Final note in-thread: after reconciliation we should run a dry-run on billing for the last 24h weekly to prevent regressions and add an alert for duplicate-replay-rate > 0.5%.

lina (support): Copy. I'll draft a customer-facing post-incident note once we have final numbers.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> active; owners: jake (billing), maria (sre); sla risk: low; customer-impact: transient overage flags for a subset of customers.

sam (oncall): Closing my shift early handoff complete. Leaving notes in the incident doc. Good work team. :thumbsup:
